Ying Woo Sin Veng ( ) (Movie and Dancing News),
Weekly, Volume 2, Issue No. 1, published the following
article on January 17 :-

NAKED DANCING IN SMALL DANCE HALLS

The business of all dance halls has been
affected by the business depression. In order to attract
patrons, many small dance halls are selling dance tickets
at ten to twelve for one dollar and some have even
employed persons to perform naked dances.

On a certain night, I went with several friends
to the Ai-Tu ("Edward") Dance Hall, Avenue Edward VII,
(International Settlement). The place was packed. A notice
was displayed on the left wall of the hall reading:"This
hall has secured a young American lady to give performances
of naked dancing as from to-night."

At 11 p.m. performance of the naked dancing
was announced. Immediately afterwards, a young girl,
entirely naked, with her breasts and the beauty of her
curves fully exposed, made her appearance. The performance
lasted about 20 minutes.

The dance hall in question did a very good
business that night. How strong an attraction is human
flesh! It is not strange that other small dance halls
are following the example of this dance hall.

与此同时，所有灯光熄灭，一束聚光灯从舞台对面射向戴着墨镜的两个女孩。当珠宝商发出脱衣信号时，两个女孩毫不犹豫地立即脱去了长袍。她们背对观众站立。随后，她们被命令脱去内衣。完成此动作后，珠宝商最终让她们转向观众。因此，全身赤裸的她们，包括乳房、肚脐、私处毛发等身体各部位，都暴露在观众眼前。这种暴露仅持续了极短的时间，因为两个女孩快速转了几圈后便退场了。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Being not fully contented with this sight, I
visited the place a second time the following night and
was again an eye-witness of the second performance. This
time the play was known as "A Visit to A Girl Guide Agency
by A Foreigner." The story of the play briefly goes as
follows:-

The first person who emerged on the stage was
the foreigner in make-up. He was dressed in worn-out
foreign clothing. He called at a girl guide agency and
said in pidgin Chinese dialect (purposely) that he had
money and that he desired to play with some nice girls.
After some conversation, the foreigner stated that he would
like to hold an inspection of the bodies of the girl guides
so as to ascertain whether she bore marks of syphilis on
her body. Here, the two girls on the stage retired and
there emerged another girl, who had a piece of blanket
around her body to cover her nudeness. The act of undressing
was performed on a chair, in the course of which all the
lights were put off, a spot light being used. This time
the exposure lasted less time as the girl only turned round
once before retiring. At the time when the girl was
standing entirely naked with her back facing towards the
audience, I noticed the large scab of a sore on her buttock.

- 2 -

对此景象尚感不足，我在次日晚上再次前往该处，并再次亲眼目睹了第二场表演。这次的剧目名为“外国人参观女童子军机构”。剧情简述如下：

第一个登上舞台的是化了妆的外国人。他穿着破旧的外国服装。他来到一家女童子军机构，故意用洋泾浜汉语方言说他有金钱，并希望与一些漂亮的女孩玩乐。经过一番交谈后，该外国人表示他想检查女童子军的身体，以确定她身上是否有梅毒的痕迹。此时，舞台上的两个女孩退场，另一个女孩登场，她身上裹着一条毯子以遮盖裸体。脱衣动作是在一把椅子上进行的，在此过程中所有灯光熄灭，仅使用聚光灯。这次的暴露时间更短，因为该女孩在退场前只转身一次。当该女孩完全赤裸、背对观众站立时，我注意到她臀部有一个疮的大痂。
